#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <cmath>
#define MAX_LEVEL 18
typedef long long ll;
using namespace std;

ll array[MAX_LEVEL];

int recursive_dfs(ll number, int position) {
    int quotient = number / array[position];
    number %= array[position];

    if (number == 0)
        return position * quotient;
    return position * quotient + min(position + recursive_dfs(array[position] - number, position - 1), recursive_dfs(number, position - 1));
}

int main() {
    array[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < MAX_LEVEL; i++)
        array[i] = array[i - 1] * 10 + 1;

    ll input_number;
    while (cin >> input_number) {
        cout << recursive_dfs(input_number, MAX_LEVEL - 1) << endl;
    }
}
